item.title: CVE-2026-35377 · uu_env incorrectly rejects backslashes within single-quoted strings accepted by GNU env
item.description: In `env -S`, GNU keeps backslashes literal inside single quotes (except `\\` and `\'`); uutils errors on sequences like `\a`. This is the backslash-handling issue of the broader `-S`/`--split-string` parsing divergence. ``` env -S"printf %s '\''\\x'\''" # GNU prints \x ; uutils: invalid sequence '\x' in -S (125) ``` --- _Zellic private finding (zellic-ext/coreutils-private PR #117). Reported in the Zellic *uutils coreutils Program Security Ass | Producto: uu_env | Corrección: 0.10.0

item.description: ### Impact `amqtt` is vulnerable to a remote denial of service caused by incomplete MQTT QoS 2 transactions remaining allocated after the associated client disconnects.
